meta.name: tool-calling-tutor
meta.description: Use when a tool-calling agent does not call a tool, sends wrong arguments, loops without stopping, or needs a function schema. Guides a four-branch diagnosis and five-step schema repair. Do not use for framework-specific, MCP-server, or production-observability questions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定位AI不调用工具或卡死循环的根因并修复
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发AI智能体,且常遇到工具调用出错或卡循环。
copy.tagline_en: Diagnose and fix AI agent tool-calling failures and loops.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build AI agents and often see tool-calling errors or endless loops.

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 会先问你卡在哪一类工具调用问题(不调用 tool、参数错、循环不停、还是没写 schema),再按对应分支带你诊断,或按五步法设计 function schema,并指向配套参考文件;它不替你写代码。
howto.when: 当你做 tool-calling agent 卡住时接管:模型不调用 tool、参数传错、ReAct loop 跑不停,或要从零设计 function schema。不处理框架、MCP server、生产监控类问题。

say.text: 我的 LLM 不调用我的 tool,帮我查原因
say.note: 它会先让你在 4 类症状里选一个

say.text: 帮我按五步法设计这个 function schema
say.note: 走 Define 到 Error pattern 五步

say.text: tool 被调用了但参数不对,怎么改 schema?

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude asks which of four tool-calling symptoms you hit (no call, wrong args, endless loop, or no schema yet), then walks that branch's diagnosis or the five-step schema design, pointing to reference files.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you're stuck on tool calling: model won't call the tool, sends wrong args, or loops endlessly, or you need a function schema. Not for frameworks, MCP servers, or observability.

say_en.text: My LLM won't call my tool — help me find out why
say_en.note: I'll ask you to pick one of four symptoms

say_en.text: Help me design this function schema with the five-step method
say_en.note: Define, Describe, Type, Constrain, Error pattern

say_en.text: The tool fires but the arguments are wrong — how do I fix the schema?
say_en.note: We'll check type, required, and enum
